name: Qiongjiu

skills.name: Fuse
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Common Rail
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 8 tile, dealing Burn damage equal to 150% of attack. Additionaly, this unit gains Support Boost I.

skills.name: Guide to Victory
skills.description: Selects 1 direction and deals AoE Burn damage equal to 110% of attack to the first enemy target within 8 tiles in the selected direction. Applies Overburn for 2 turns.

skills.name: Pressing the Momentum
skills.description: Gains 3 stacks of Support Boost II. At max Confectance Index, gains 1 additional stack and increases the maximum number of Action Support this turn by 1.

skills.name: Steady Plan
skills.description:
Gains 1 point of Confectance Index each time after dealing damage. Increases damage dealt to targets not under the protection of Cover by 10%.

When an enemy unit within range receives targeted damage from an ally, performs 1 instance of Action Support, dealing Physical damage equal to 90% of attack and 2 points of Stability Damage. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times per turn.

fortification.effect: If a kill is scored, increases the damage bonus of Support Boost I to 30%.
If the target is inflicted with Overburn, increases the critical rate of this attack by 100%.
After Action Support, apply Overburn to the target for 2 turns. Action Support's damage increases by 10%.
Applies Vulnerable I to targets that are not protected by Cover for 1 turn.
When performing Action Support, applies Damage Up II to self and the allied unit for 1 turn before the aforementioned allied unit makes their attack.
Increases damage deat by 10% against targets without Cover protection.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Concentration
keys.effect: Gains 3 points of Confectance Index at the start of the battle.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Efficient Planning
keys.effect: Before Support Action, dispels 1 buff from the target.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Targeted Training
keys.effect: While in Support Mode, applies Defense Down II to the target for 1 turn before the allied unit's attack.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Point of Vulnerability
keys.effect: Modify the effects of the active skill Guide to Victory to deal damage to all enemy targets within 8 tiles in the selected direction. All enemy targets except the first receive 30% less damage.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Necessary Adjustments
keys.effect: When a Phase Weakness is exploited using the active skill Common Rail, gains Blazing Assault II for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Steadiness
keys.effect: When under the effect of Support Boost, gain immunity to displacement effects applied by enemy units.

keys.name: Common Key - Strategic Negotiation
keys.effect: CRIT +5.0% / Increases damage dealt outside of the unit's own turn by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key - Ruined Gem
keys.effect: Damage type dealt by Action Support is changed to Burn damage, and damage dealt to targets with Burn debuffs is increased by 15%.
